name: Shop-Floor OS
tagline: AI agents plan, robots execute, humans judge.
domain: Fictional car final-assembly hall: incident response and AGV dispatch

meterless_engines.evidence: tests/test_world_model.py ports the spec's 8 conformance checks plus the reference smoke tests

used_by: app/engines/playbooks.py (critic lessons recalled before planning, outcome feedback)
meterless_engines.evidence: tests/test_hmem.py runs the spec's 13 conformance vectors (tests/fixtures/hmem_vectors.json)

meterless_engines.spec: Meterless Markovian Agent Engine reference (headless, v1.0)
used_by: app/handover.py (run.py handover: shift journal in bounded chunks, then a handover note)
meterless_engines.evidence: tests/test_markovian.py (config bounds, markers, compression cascade order, token formulas, abort, reflection failure); logs/markovian.jsonl run records

memory: app/engines/playbooks.py: incident playbooks running on the H-MEM engine

models.provider: Meterless Nightshift only (OpenAI-compatible); every model is NVIDIA
models.registry: config/models.json (role -> model chain, latency and token budgets); app/models.py (per-model circuit breakers, fallback, requested vs answering model, Nightshift receipt id per call)
models.probe: scripts/probe_models.py -> data/model_probe.json (which model Nightshift really serves per requested id)
models.nightshift_routing_note: Nightshift routes by per-app rule: shopfloor-os-ultra -> Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, shopfloor-os -> Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, shopfloor-os-fast -> Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (one-lane allowlists in Nightshift's app policy); every call records requested vs answering model and the receipt id, and the Ed25519 receipt signature is verified at call time

data_platform: Zetaris: four Postgres sources federated as sf_fleet, sf_hr, sf_plant, sf_ops; one federated query per incident; Unified Semantic Layer 'floor' (app/usl.py, 9 tables with keys); agents read on a read-only login (role SF_AGENT_READER); agent logs synced back into sf_ops.agent_steps, llm_calls, journal

agent_loop.kind: dynamic orchestrator (app/dynamic.py); the fixed pipeline is kept as --linear
agent_loop.router: router role (config/models.json) returns strict JSON {next_agent, reason, args} per decision point; rule-based router in sample mode, when Nightshift is down, and after 6 router calls
guardrails_in_code: executor only after critic + dry run + human gate
illegal or unknown router choices rejected and logged
Nightshift down -> safe mode replaces the planner

routes.false_alarm: monitor -> investigator -> verify_plan -> critic -> VERIFY (no planner)
routes.verifier_mismatch: -> candidates without the failed AGV -> planner

safety: Deterministic critic over OSHA 29 CFR 1910 rule summaries; restraint gate (ACT, SAFE_HOLD, VERIFY, ESCALATE, DO_NOTHING); circuit-breaker safe mode

demo.offline: SAMPLE_MODE=true python -m app.server  (replays recorded Nemotron replies; no keys, no Zetaris)
cases: part_shortage at F30 (critic rejection then retry)

tests: python -m pytest  (313 offline tests: Meterless conformance, guardrails, model registry and resilience, anytime planning, journal, autopilot, detectors, caches, SQL guard, intake, Lab loop, VDA 5050, offline verification, property-based safety fuzzing)
data_sources: See README: synthetic plant anchored on UCI AI4I 2020, OSHA SIR, BLS SOII, Open-Meteo, Bosch CNC, MovingAI MAPF

entry_points.programmatic: python run.py run input_examples/example_1.json  (JSON in, JSON out)
entry_points.http: POST /run or POST /api/run with an input_examples/*.json body on python -m app.server (port $PORT, default 8000); GET /health
entry_points.ui: python -m app.server -> http://127.0.0.1:8000 (Live floor with report form, Incidents with agent flow and history, Ask the floor, Lab, Nemotron at work, What the agents know)
entry_points.docker: docker build -t shopfloor-os . && docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 shopfloor-os

logs: logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl per incident (hop, agent, why, chosen by, model requested/answered, receipt), logs/trace-ask-<id>.jsonl per investigation, logs/llm.jsonl per model call, logs/approvals.jsonl per human judgement; python run.py watch follows them live
sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true: offline plant, recorded Nemotron replies where available, rule-based planner otherwise; real agent logic, no network

sponsors.zetaris: data layer: one federated query per incident over sf_fleet, sf_hr, sf_plant, sf_ops; lab writes via INSERT
sponsors.meterless: World Model, H-MEM and Markovian engines (Python ports, conformance-tested: tests/test_world_model.py, tests/test_hmem.py, tests/test_markovian.py); Nightshift is the only model provider
sponsors.nvidia: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (planner, analyst, Lab), nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b (NEMOTRON_DEEP: coordinator, SQL agent, handover) and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b (NEMOTRON_FAST: router, monitor, Sentinel, evidence critic), all via Meterless Nightshift

pre_existing_components: none (repository started 2026-10-23, inside the build window)

entry_points: python run.py ask "Why does F10 keep stopping?"
POST /ask on the server (SSE ask_step / ask_result), UI tab 'Ask the floor'
sample_questions: Which AGV is least reliable and when?

incident_kinds.without_playbook: fenced and escalated with a reason

retrieval: H-MEM-ranked OSHA/SOP clauses for planner and critic, H-MEM lessons and playbooks, World Model grounding from one Zetaris query, guarded SQL and trace search for investigations; no vector DB
context_limits: largest prompt ~7.5k tokens vs 262k (Lightning) / 1M (Super VL); app/models.py skips a model if prompt + max_tokens exceeds half its window; per-role max_tokens and budget_s; 15-row previews, 200-row SQL cap; hop budget 24, 6 router calls
failure_handling: model chain fallback on timeout/5xx/429/empty/invalid JSON, per-model circuit breakers, Nightshift-wide breaker -> rule-based router + safe mode (ESCALATE), all recorded in the trace

autopilot.sentinel: rules, dedupe, AGV-fault/shortage correlation, Lightning triage of ambiguous signals; people-risk never dismissed; logs/sentinel.jsonl
autopilot.dispatcher: priority queue (people, severity, expected cost), N concurrent incidents, urgent jump-in; cooperative (deterministic) or threaded
autopilot.leases: per worker/AGV with expiry; pre-emption by risk; critic rule R-LEASE; arbiter steps in the trace
autopilot.caching: app/cache.py: Zetaris read cache (write invalidates), incident history, clause retrieval, replay hits; /health

resilience.model_calls: retries with full-jitter backoff on 5xx/429/empty/timeouts, per-model AIMD concurrency, hedged requests for router/monitor/sentinel, incident deadline, JSON repair then one re-ask, half-open single probe (app/models.py, app/resilience.py)
resilience.anytime_planning: optimal assignment (Hungarian) plan v1 in milliseconds; Nemotron v2 swapped in only if it passes critic + dry run and scores better (app/agents/assign.py, refine hop)
resilience.model_self_check: startup probe per pinned model, effective chain, live pin-drift warnings in /health
resilience.durable_state: hash-chained (HMAC) journal with crash recovery, fencing tokens, idempotent dispatch, signed approvals; run.py audit (app/journal.py, app/connectors.py)
resilience.runtime_safety: invariant monitor after every tick (AGV in fence with a person, crossing speed, lockout/tagout, collisions); fleet-layer crossing speed limit; default-deny for uncheckable rules; property-based fuzzing (app/sim/invariants.py, tests/test_fuzz_safety.py)
resilience.adaptive_detection: EWMA baselines from sf_plant.machine_telemetry per machine and shift, CUSUM drift, stock trend, fixed per-machine hard limits (app/autonomy/detectors.py)
resilience.cars_saved: bootstrap 95% interval over historical incidents per kind
resilience.connectors: FleetManager / MES / PLC interfaces with simulator implementations (app/connectors.py)
